regions.merged_text: Thank God for HOPE. The soul of our happiness here. Hence: "The fool sayeth in his heart: 'There is no God. '" Hle refuses to be happy - in refusing to hope. And the very idea of God and of eternity with Him, as inspired by faith, hope, charity, is the fountain of supernatural confidence, of hope, of happiness. If we be friends we'll pray for one another's conver- sion - while we breathe.

regions.merged_text: Purpose of the Rational Creature God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aiml To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same. It's Heaven-begun for The grateful on Earth - To treasure aright ?!!! Highest Heaven its worth.
